movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Bulldoze
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are lowered 1 Speed Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Mud-Slap
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1.

movelist.name: Magnitude
movelist.effect: When you use Magnitude, roll 1d6.  Magnitude’s Damage Base is equal to 5+X, where X is the value of the d6. Magnitude can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. This is increased to +2 Evasion while in a Sandstorm or sandy terrain. While in a Sandstorm, the user and adjacent allies do not lose Hit Points due to the Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Polycephaly
abilities.effect: The user may make Struggle Attacks as a Swift Action.  Struggle Attacks made this way are resisted one step further than they normally would be.
